name: push_adb_file
description: Push one local file to an absolute device path. The only device-mutating ADB tool: existing device files are refused unless overwrite is explicitly requested, and the transfer is verified by comparing the local digest with the device's own sha256sum when the device provides one.

__schema0.description: Device serial exactly as `adb devices` reports it

__schema1.description: Existing local regular file to push

__schema2.description: Absolute destination path on the device

__schema3.description: Allow replacing an existing device file; refused by default

device_path.description: Absolute destination path on the device

local_path.description: Existing local regular file to push

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing device file; refused by default

serial.description: Device serial exactly as `adb devices` reports it
